title: Accept independent audit results and certify zero-repeat closure
description:
Terminal gate of eshyra-o9bd.19. Receives the independent max-effort re-audit
result from eshyra-o9bd.16 and certifies zero-repeat closure, or refuses.

This bead exists so the .19 hierarchy stays open THROUGH the independent audit
rather than closing on its own automated gates, and so eshyra-o9bd.16 is used
rather than silently superseded by the new program.

Certification requires that independent review reports NO repeat finding. Any NEW
finding blocks re-freeze, is added to the finding registry BEFORE any repair
starts, and is assigned an owning bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- The independent re-audit (eshyra-o9bd.16) has completed and its results are recorded here.
- Independent review reports zero REPEAT findings from the 2026-07-24 corpus.
- Every new finding, if any, is registered with an owning bead before repair begins, and this bead stays open until they close.
- Certification is explicit and dated; eshyra-o9bd.14 may not proceed without it.
notes:
Added on review of the original closure wiring, which let eshyra-o9bd.14,
eshyra-o9bd.16 and eshyra-2zyy all proceed in parallel after 19.6.3 — that
neither enforced the intended sequence nor used the pre-existing final-audit
bead.
